model_output_raw.confidence_explanation: The evidence shows a clear pattern of an authorized user (user_04) with 'read_only' access and a baseline of 0 downloads per day performing 6 file downloads. Crucially, this user accessed files outside their department (Engineering projects) and worked significantly outside their normal hours (until 19:00). This behavior deviates sharply from their baseline and role, indicating unauthorized data exfiltration consistent with an insider threat.

attack_chain.description: user_04 logs in from normal IP within normal hours.
user_04 performs first download (accounts_receivable), violating baseline of 0 downloads/day.
user_04 accesses Engineering project data (project_alpha), crossing departmental boundaries.
user_04 accesses second Engineering project (project_beta), expanding scope of unauthorized access.
user_04 continues downloading sensitive finance files (bank_reconciliation) while others are likely offline.
user_04 downloads large general ledger file, significantly increasing data volume exfiltrated.
user_04 accesses Engineering data again at 17:15, outside normal working hours (09:00-17:00).
user_04 logs out at 19:00, having worked 2 hours past normal shift to complete data collection.

gaps: No ticket number or maintenance justification metadata found for user_04's off-hours activity or cross-department access.
No evidence of user_04's specific role permissions regarding the Engineering shared folders (though baseline suggests they shouldn't be there).
No network traffic logs to confirm if the downloaded files were actually exfiltrated off-premises or just saved locally.
model_output_raw.narrative: user_04, a junior accountant with read-only access and a baseline of zero daily downloads, systematically downloaded six sensitive financial files and accessed engineering project data outside their department. The user extended their session two hours past normal working hours to complete this data collection, exhibiting a classic insider threat pattern of unauthorized data exfiltration.
